findings.text: Unfortunate in the sense that we often don't truly develop
findings.what: Breaks the pair with "Fortunately in the sense that..." in the sentence before; the adverb "Unfortunately" is meant.

findings.text: and try one peace yourself while they're still helping
findings.what: "Peace" stands where "piece" belongs: you take over one piece of the adult role while they still help with the rest.
findings.fix: and try one piece yourself while they're still helping

findings.text: it isn't a free new-age get-out-of-jail-free card
findings.what: "Free" is said twice: a get-out-of-jail-free card is already free, so the first "free" doubles it.
findings.fix: it isn't a new-age get-out-of-jail-free card

findings.text: Even if every case is different, I'd read a few of those cases
findings.what: The clause should concede a weakness in the cases, and "different" concedes nothing, so the sentence doesn't hold together; a word like "debatable" seems meant.
findings.fix: Even if every case is debatable, I'd read a few of those cases

notes: Not reported, but worth a look: block 19's list of five stages has no "1." before "Forced adulthood" (probably lost when the list was run into one block); block 11 has an unspaced "--" where the rest of the part uses a spaced en dash; "molding" (block 4) and "moulding" (block 76) differ; and "(X)" in block 8 reads like an unfilled placeholder unless it stands in for her name on purpose. Block 157's "tuberculosis from a cave" is his own history, but the lung infection usually caught in caves is histoplasmosis, so it may be worth confirming with him.
